description.narrative: The project contributes to the Paris Agreement and SDG 7 by enhancing intra-Commonwealth cooperation on sustainable energy transition. Intra-Commonwealth cooperation on low carbon development will require concerted efforts by member countries to accelerate the energy transition at the lowest economic and social cost while achieving universal access to clean and affordable energy. This will be realised through: the establishment of member-led action groups, capacity building, international cooperation and collaboration, development of knowledge products and technical assistance in respect of sustainable energy transitions.?
